reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves the upstream need records and maps only exact need text matches to direct capability coverage, leaving missing capabilities as unsupported with empty capability_id. This matches the declared role and the visible final coverage rows.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve exact upstream need records and allowed record identifiers
map exact handoff needs to direct capability coverage
use missing-safe sentinels for uncovered needs

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize_needs inverts the unsupported flag by setting unsupported to true when coverage == 'direct'. The declared behavior requires unsupported needs to rank before covered needs, but the output ranks covered direct needs first and pushes actually unsupported records n06-r01 and n06-r07 to priorities 7 and 8. This changes the recommendation frontier consumed downstream.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank unsupported needs before covered needs
use upstream provenance rank as primary ordering within each group
preserve priority fields and record identifiers

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize_recommendation retains the explicit eight-item priority window and builds the recommendation from the already-ranked first priority record. The recommendation is wrong only because its input priorities are already misranked by the upstream prioritize_needs boundary.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: construct recommendation from already-ranked first priority record
independently establish correct customer-demand top need
